turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on weather words?
turns.tutor:
I'll think aloud with one: "Wear your coat and gloves. It is ___ today."
A coat and gloves keep us warm. We need them when the air is not warm. So the word is cold.
Result: Wear your coat and gloves.
Rule: look at the clue, then pick the weather word that matches it.
Right: The sky is blue and bright. It is sunny.
Wrong: The sky is blue and bright. It is cloudy.
Now you. Complete: "Take an umbrella. It is ___ today."
